# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server across an S&D round restart.
# map mp_carentan, gametype sd, joined axis, weapon kar98k_mp, role roundrestart-target
# dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock scr_* defaults but for the
# limit cvars the recipe sets. Two probes on opposite teams, target first:
#   tools/run_server.sh mp_carentan +set g_gametype sd +set scr_sd_roundlength 1 \
#     +set scr_friendlyfire 1
#   --net-probe <ip:port> --probe-team axis --probe-target --save-roundrestart \
#     --probe-secs 200
#   --net-probe <ip:port> --probe-team allies --save-roundrestart --probe-secs 160
# The probe sends `score` every 2 s, and retail sends the `b` scoreboard only
# in answer to one, so every `b` line here was asked for, not pushed.
# One !gamestate per gamestate, one !cmd per serverCommand with its reliable
# sequence, one !oob per connectionless packet, and one !trace per snapshot
# whose watched fields moved plus one a second so a settled stretch still
# carries a timeline. ms is since the capture started; serverTime is the
# server's own clock. ammoclip is the non-zero entries, as index:value.
role roundrestart-target
